name: Palazzo Farnese

dates.note: The French Embassy's own chronology states the total as 'settantasei anni di lavori (1513-1589)' and then dates the start of construction to 1514 -- the two lines of the same page differ by a year. The node's exemplar note gives 1517-1589. All three are recorded and none is changed.

refs.title: Palazzo Farnese | La Francia in Italia
refs.note: The Palace has housed the French Embassy since 1874 and the Ecole francaise de Rome from the following year; this is the Embassy's own history page.

refs.title: Farnese Palace - Palazzo Farnese
refs.note: The Embassy's official visit site, which names the four architects as 'Sangallo the Younger, Michelangelo, the Vignola Giacomo Della Porta' and dates completion to 1589. Read in a search result.

quotes.text:
1546: Morte di Antonio da Sangallo. Michelangelo riprende il cantiere.
   1546-49: Michelangelo crea il cornicione, completa il cortile e chiude le logge del primo piano.
   1549: Morte di Papa Paolo III. Compimento della facciata principale.

quotes.text: 1514: Inizia la costruzione, sotto la responsabilità di Antonio da Sangallo il Giovane.

measurements.note: Not a dimension. It is carried because the node reads this palace as its reference for storey grading and cornice proportion, and the register's own figure says the front took four architects and three generations -- which is an argument against treating any one elevation rule as this building's.

note: Tranche 3, the antique orders cluster, 5 Sep 2026. The node calls this 'the reference palazzo for storey grading and cornice proportion' and the register supports the ATTRIBUTION of the cornice and nothing about its size: '1546-49: Michelangelo crea il cornicione'. No dimension of any kind was found in a state or institutional text for this building.
